title: Week 2026-W42: 4 releases, 1 needs action
headline: Ollama 0.9 changes a default; Vitest 5 and Node 24.1 are worth a look.

items.title: Ollama 0.9
items.whatChanged: The default context window grows from 2k to 4k tokens.
items.action: Pin num_ctx in your Modelfiles before upgrading.

items.title: Vitest 5.0
items.whatChanged: Browser mode is stable and the default runner is faster.
items.action: Teams testing UI components should try it.

items.title: Node 24.1
items.whatChanged: Security fixes for the HTTP parser.

items.title: pnpm 10.34
items.whatChanged: Fixes a lockfile race & clearer install logs.
